authority: DESIGN ONLY — NOT EXECUTED in Stage 1. Specifies how a future Stage 2 baseline competition would compare candidate targets fairly and leakage-free. Reuses existing infrastructure (arch_competition eval manifest + lineage) and names the missing temporal-discipline + multiple-comparison pieces that MUST be built before Stage 2 runs.

eligible_targets.rule: A target may enter Stage 2 ONLY if target_registry_v1 gives it promotion_status == EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE AND its experiment_readiness independently computes eligible (causal_contract_proven AND every applicable readiness gate .ok). This is enforced mechanically by research.stage1_target_foundation.target_registry.stage2_eligible_targets(reg), which is fail-closed: a merely CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN or DATA_QUALITY_PROVEN target is NOT returned.
eligible_targets.currently_eligible_note: ZERO targets are EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE in this Stage 1 foundation. outcome_H_ternary_legacy is LEGACY_BASELINE_ONLY (a baseline to beat, never an entrant on its own merit). outcome_H_pts_raw / outcome_dir_H_conditional / outcome_move_H_binary are CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN but blocked by data-quality/overlap gates. Stage 2 CANNOT run until at least one target is promoted to EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE by closing its gates.
eligible_targets.causal_proven_is_not_eligible: Being reconstructable from immutable rows (CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN) is a causality statement ONLY and does NOT confer eligibility.

label_span_semantics.rule: the nominal 'Nc' horizon realizes an anchor_close->forward_close span of (N+1) whole minutes, NOT N (see target_registry_v1.horizon_span_semantics).
label_span_semantics.binding: purge, embargo, and horizon alignment MUST use the true (N+1)-minute span. The nominal 60c target MUST be treated as a span of at least 61 minutes.

economic_targets: mean post-cost return (must be > 0 after costs)

preregistered_primary_metric.classification: MCC (Matthews correlation coefficient) is the PREREGISTERED primary metric for every classification target — chosen because it is robust to the flat-majority / conditional class imbalance that degenerate accuracy hides. Secondary metrics are reported but do not decide advancement.
preregistered_primary_metric.regression: pinball loss at preregistered quantiles is the primary metric for regression/excursion targets.
preregistered_primary_metric.no_post_hoc_switching: The primary metric and the target definition are FROZEN before any test-window evaluation. Switching the primary metric, the target, or the horizon after seeing test results is FORBIDDEN and is a stop condition.

splits_and_leakage_control.temporal_split: NESTED walk-forward, out-of-time; train windows strictly precede validation windows which strictly precede test windows by ts_utc. Inner folds select hyperparameters/models; the outer fold estimates generalization.
splits_and_leakage_control.final_holdout: a single, UNTOUCHED final holdout window (latest ts_utc block) is reserved and evaluated EXACTLY ONCE for the preregistered winner. It is never used for selection, tuning, or metric choice.
splits_and_leakage_control.purge: REQUIRED — drop training rows whose (N+1)-minute label window overlaps any validation/test anchor (overlapping 1m horizon labels leak without purge).
splits_and_leakage_control.embargo: REQUIRED — embargo gap >= the true max realized label span = 61 minutes (61 one-minute bars) for a book spanning up to 60c, NOT 60 bars, between train and test to remove serial-correlation leakage.
splits_and_leakage_control.session_splits: rth-only primary (RTH = 08:30-15:00 CT via ct_session); premarket/afterhours as explicit transfer experiments (never silently pooled)
splits_and_leakage_control.time_of_day_splits: open / midday / close cohorts reported separately (microstructure differs)
splits_and_leakage_control.MISSING_TODAY: arch_competition/ implements single-window OOS + half-split stability only; NESTED walk-forward, purge, embargo, and the untouched final holdout are NOT implemented and MUST be built before Stage 2

multiple_comparison_control.why: Stage 2 compares many targets x horizons x models x cohorts. Without family-wise control, a false 'winner' is near-certain by chance.
multiple_comparison_control.family_definition: the comparison family is the full grid of {eligible target} x {horizon} x {model} x {cohort} evaluated in a run; it MUST be declared before the run.
multiple_comparison_control.fwer_or_fdr: control either FWER (Holm-Bonferroni) or FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) across the declared family; the chosen procedure and alpha are preregistered.
multiple_comparison_control.data_snooping_tests: apply White's Reality Check AND/OR Hansen's SPA test across the model/target set to test whether the best performer beats the benchmark after accounting for the search; report the SPA p-value.
multiple_comparison_control.deflated_sharpe: for any economic/return target, report the Deflated Sharpe Ratio (Bailey & Lopez de Prado) accounting for the number of trials, skew, kurtosis, and sample length; a positive raw Sharpe that is not DSR-significant does NOT advance.
multiple_comparison_control.seeds: every stochastic model is run over a preregistered set of >= 5 seeds; report mean and dispersion; a result that is not stable across seeds does not advance.
multiple_comparison_control.class_imbalance_policy: class imbalance is handled by class weighting and threshold selection reported on the validation fold ONLY; NO oversampling/SMOTE on overlapping financial series (it fabricates leakage); the imbalance handling is frozen before test evaluation.
multiple_comparison_control.model_selection_log: every model/target/hyperparameter/metric considered is written to an append-only model-selection log with its fold results, so the true number of trials feeding FWER/FDR/DSR is auditable and cannot be understated.

costs: every economic comparison names a cost_model_registry_v1 id; a target that cannot beat baselines AFTER costs is not advanced
baselines_required: legacy_ternary_label (LEGACY_BASELINE_ONLY entrant — must be beaten, not judged on its own merit)
shuffle_control (labels permuted — must score at chance)
calibration: reliability + ECE per cohort; regime-conditional calibration (arch_competition.metrics supports climatology-baseline Brier skill, ECE/MCE, regime-conditional bins)
confidence_intervals: bootstrap CIs on the primary metric; report CI overlap vs baselines AND the multiple-comparison-adjusted significance (FWER/FDR/SPA)
sample_requirements: MIN_SAMPLES_STATISTICAL floor per cell (arch_competition eval_runner:190); movement labels currently cover ~9.1% of governed rows -> insufficient until backfilled
latency_budget: any target whose live scoring path exceeds the production inference budget is disqualified regardless of offline lift
reproducibility: each run pins scheduler_run_manifest lineage (feature_cache_key / data_fingerprint / training_code_fingerprint / ml_horizon_suffix / schema_version) per arch_competition/lineage.py; evaluation_manifest schema v1; plus the preregistration record (family, primary metric, alpha, procedure, seeds) and the model-selection log
simplicity_penalty: ties broken toward the simpler model; a complex model must beat a simple baseline by more than the multiple-comparison-adjusted CI to be preferred
stop_conditions: no target is EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE (stage2_eligible_targets == []) -> Stage 2 MUST NOT run
any proposed entrant is not EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE per the registry selection function -> reject that entrant (fail-closed)
the preregistered primary metric (MCC for classification) is absent from a comparison -> STOP
post-hoc switching of target, horizon, or primary metric after test evaluation -> INVALIDATE the run
no candidate target beats the simple baselines AND the legacy baseline AFTER costs and multiple-comparison adjustment -> STOP (do not advance any target)
the best performer is not significant under White's Reality Check / Hansen SPA (or DSR for economic targets) -> STOP (likely data-snooping)
shuffle_control scores above chance -> STOP (leakage present, fix before continuing)
movement/economic label coverage below the sample floor -> STOP pending backfill
nested walk-forward / purge / embargo (>=61 min) / untouched final holdout not implemented -> Stage 2 MUST NOT run
explicitly_not_in_scope: SVR / zero-shot / foundation-model production inference (foundation-model is a recorded exclusion)
